meta.title: Decision Engine
meta.description: A decision model judges before the main model acts: structured questions (risk, reversibility, task relevance, injection suspicion) are answered, so each call is allowed, escalated or blocked — or rerouted to a cheaper model, or skipped entirely. The plugin provides a free decision model, so a fresh install works out of the box; any other service exposing a decision endpoint works too (built-in presets or a custom base URL). Shadow-first by default, fail-open on any error.
